account.description: The account it puts in force.

approval_id.description: The approval request it waits for.

callback_note.description: Who called the vendor back, when, and on which number: a number known before, never one from the letter.
examples: Called Jane Tan, Northwind finance, on 6123 4567 from our records, 27 Oct 2026 10:15

checks.description: A draft or waiting change: what stops it being asked for or approved (✖), and the warnings it is asked for with (⚠). Empty in a list.

in_force.description: Its account is the vendor's account for its currency now.

prepared_by.description: Who saved its current version: an actor of the audit trail.

replaces.description: A draft or waiting change: the account in force it would replace, if any.

status.description: draft: being prepared; waiting: asked for, waiting for approval, and payments to the vendor are frozen; approved: in force, or replaced since (in_force says).

version.description: The change's version; with its status it makes the ETag.
